title: Production storefront verification completed with explicit authentication gaps
summary: Confirmed READY release and live alias; public storefront, images, cart, checkout entry, shipping quotes and sampled SEO pass. Authenticated owner login, owner database runtime and field CWV remain unverified. No application changes or deployment.

changes.detail: Added current deployment evidence, smoke-test matrix, SEO completion matrix and prioritized continuation roadmap; preserved all historical evidence and unrelated work.
Corrected Fetch status accessors in the new audit harness after two retained partial attempts. No production application fix, removal, deployment, migration or secret change.

validation.name: Release identity and integrity
validation.detail: Vercel READY and apex alias agree with Git 1f17d9e8c54f960b8ba873dfe0974075ed8a9e4a; all 2578 manifest file hashes match; four crons retained.

validation.name: Public commerce and browser smoke
validation.detail: HTTP checks, 115 decoded image instances, actual variant selection/local cart persistence, checkout entry, eight 375/1440 viewport cases and two read-only shipping quotes passed; no order or payment submitted.

validation.name: SEO and reliability sample
validation.detail: Metadata and parsed schema, robots/63-entry sitemap, product social image, 30 links, 404/noindex and anonymous access checks passed. No observed browser exceptions/5xx; bounded provider log queries returned no records. Canonicalized duplicate 200 URL surfaces documented.

validation.name: History tests
validation.detail: Four focused change-history tests passed before append.

validation.name: Remaining verification
validation.detail: Authenticated owner session lifecycle, deployed owner database/TLS, live Arabic behavior, complete shipping boundaries, Search Console, external rich-results validation, IndexNow delivery and field Core Web Vitals unverified. Prior build/regression results not rerun.
